report_title: Enterprise Resilience Architecture & Strategy Specification Report

strategies.name: Downstream Service Isolation via Circuit Breaking
strategies.purpose: Prevent cascading failure by cutting off faulty AI providers, DB queries, or OCR services
strategies.activation_condition: Failure rate exceeds 50% or 5 consecutive timeouts within 30 seconds
strategies.recovery_action: Trip circuit breaker to OPEN, route to fallback, schedule probe requests after 30s
strategies.exit_condition: 3 consecutive successful probe requests in HALF-OPEN state

strategies.name: Bounded Exponential Backoff with Jitter
strategies.purpose: Absorb transient network spikes and database lock contention safely
strategies.activation_condition: Transient HTTP 429/503 or DB connection timeout
strategies.recovery_action: Retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (200ms -> 5000ms max) + full jitter; route to DLQ upon exhaustion
strategies.automation_policy: Autonomous with Global Retry Budget Cap (20%)

strategies.name: Multi-Tier Graceful Degradation
strategies.purpose: Maintain core document ingestion and status queries even when AI or primary DB is degraded
strategies.activation_condition: AI Provider Outage or DB Primary Read-Only Failover
strategies.recovery_action: Serve cached extractions, fallback to native PDF parsing, buffer writes to Redis offline queue
strategies.exit_condition: Primary downstream health status revalidated GREEN

strategies.name: Resource Bulkhead Isolation
strategies.purpose: Prevent heavy document OCR or AI batch jobs from starving real-time status and ingestion APIs
strategies.activation_condition: Resource contention or worker pool saturation
strategies.recovery_action: Enforce strict thread pool quotas and queue capacities per domain tier

strategies.name: Adaptive Load Shedding and Priority Admission Control
strategies.purpose: Protect system stability under extreme CPU/memory overload
strategies.activation_condition: Host CPU > 85% or Memory > 90% or P99 Latency > 2000ms
strategies.recovery_action: Shed low-priority batch jobs and telemetry; prioritize interactive ingestion and health probes
strategies.exit_condition: System CPU < 75% and Memory < 80% for 60 consecutive seconds

strategies.name: Automated Self-Healing and State Recovery
strategies.purpose: Autonomously detect dead workers, stale locks, and orphaned tasks without human intervention
strategies.activation_condition: Heartbeat timeout > 45s, lock age > TTL, or task in PROCESSING for > 300s
strategies.recovery_action: Evict stale lock, recycle dead worker process, reset orphaned task to PENDING with backoff
strategies.exit_condition: Worker re-registered and orphaned task recovered
